title: 5 May 2012: Paul McCartney live at Estadio Omnilife, Guadalajara, Mexico
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estadio Omnilife in Guadalajara, Mexico, on 5 May 2012.

It was the 30th show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012. This concert was seen by 27,186 fans.

This was the first of three Mexican concerts, the others taking place in Mexico City on 8 and 10 May.

A mariachi band was brought onto the stage for ‘Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da’. Other changes from McCartney’s standard setlist were the inclusion of ‘Every Night’ and ‘Things We Said Today’.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
